claim_statement: Dual-relation learning decouples co-membership from directed adjacency, slashing false merges
evidentiary_notes: Decoupled P_same clustering reduced false merges by 73.1% compared to single-relation greedy baseline.

claim_statement: MILP discrete optimization recovers interleaved files that cause greedy beam search to fracture
supporting_experiment: Controlled Fragmentation Scenarios (SCEN_B/C/D vs Beam Search)
evidentiary_notes: Under 2-file interleaving, beam search suffered 100% false split rate while MILP achieved bit-perfect SHA-256 recovery.

claim_statement: Isotonic regression significantly outperforms Platt scaling for calibrating Random Forest probabilities
evidentiary_notes: Tree step functions violate Platt sigmoid assumptions; Isotonic regression cut ECE by 49.4% (next) and 70.9% (same).

claim_statement: Standard split conformal prediction guarantees exact finite-sample coverage on held-out forensic disks
evidentiary_notes: Violation of exchangeability due to pairwise graph sharing deflates coverage to 89.14%; requires group-conformal margins.

claim_statement: Multi-tier format validation (L0-L4) eliminates syntactically invalid paths without biasing ML models
supporting_experiment: Component Ablation Study (A05 / A07 vs Full ForenSight)
evidentiary_notes: Format boundary guards prohibit illegal cross-format edges, reducing false merges by 40.0% on heterogeneous test data.

claim_statement: Cost-sensitive selective abstention maintains >95% accuracy by rejecting ambiguous or corrupt blocks
evidentiary_notes: Rejecting unresolvable candidates under high entropy/margin deficit maintains 96.2% precision on accepted files.

claim_statement: GNN relational message passing (GraphSAGE/GAT) improves candidate edge discrimination over raw trees
evidentiary_notes: GNN message passing over-smoothed representations on dense candidate graphs, reducing top-1 edge discrimination.

claim_statement: k-NN boundary indexing reduces pairwise evaluation complexity by over 95% without recall loss
evidentiary_notes: Reduced candidate edges from 999,000 to 6,000 for N=1000, lowering graph construction runtime to 1.38s.

claim_statement: ForenSight reconstructs 100% of fragmented files across arbitrary real-world disk images
evidentiary_notes: Exact SHA-256 recovery drops to 30% under adversarial storms with 10% missing and 10% corrupted blocks.
